title: Gate 1 scenario dataset
description: Source-of-truth dataset for the Gate 1 scenario admissibility filter. One record = one (event x appraisal x persona) combination. The injury dimension lives on the appraisal, never on the event.

subject_model.description: The model under study. No record's generator_model may equal this value (build aborts if it does).

event.description: Objective description of the event. No subjective interpretation. onset and duration are independent axes and must not be collapsed.

event_id.description: Shared when one event text is reused across multiple appraisals.

text.description: Neutral factual narration, no emotional evaluation.

event_age.description: Age at which the event occurred. Distinct from persona.assessment_age.

shift_note.description: The threshold at which the injury changes in KIND (not degree). null = no threshold.

appraisal.description: First-person interpretation of the event. THE INJURY DIMENSION LIVES HERE. Must not introduce facts absent from the event text.

text.description: First-person interpretation. Must not introduce facts absent from the event text.

valence.description: benign = matched control: same event text, non-injurious interpretation.

assessment_age.description: Age at assessment. Distinct from event.event_age.

congruent.description: false = dissonant combination (e.g. extraverted/confident x severe trauma); a separately labelled arm.

instrument_set.description: Derived from assessment_age (<18 -> adolescent, else adult) but STORED explicitly, never inferred at runtime.

injection_format.description: first_person_memory = main line; second_person_assignment = ceiling arm; no_injection = baseline condition (persona with no injected scenario) used for the persona/condition coverage check.

sampling_seed.description: Seed for re-running the same material and persona.

generator_model.description: Generating model. Must differ from subject_model.

why.description: One or two sentences of rationale.

probe_ids.description: Probes that can detect this record (must reference probes.json).

refusal_rate.description: Measured refusal rate from pilot; null if not yet measured.
